title: Message a company straight from the Accounts list
text: Each company in the Accounts list now has a small chat icon next to its name. Click it and the Message window opens right over the list with that company's chat already chosen: pick the topic (and who it is addressed to, for a company with several members), write the message and send. You never leave the list.
points: The window says plainly that everyone linked to the company can read the message, and who the portal alert and email go to: only one person, not the whole company.
If nobody at the company can read the chat yet (no working portal login and no active teammate), the window says so. The message is still saved in the chat.
A company whose chat the client can't see (closed, cancelled, offboarding or still being formed) has the icon greyed out, with the reason when you point at it.
The same check now also covers people who log in with a different email than the one on their record, so the Contacts list and Contact page no longer warn about them by mistake.
